policy.subject_line: Healthcare Policy at a Crossroads: What's Moving in June
policy.theme_of_week: Fiscal pressure forces hard choices across the health system
policy.editors_note: Budget reconciliation is casting a long shadow over every corner of health policy, with Medicaid financing, Medicare Advantage payment rates, and ACA subsidy extensions all caught in the same fiscal squeeze. The tensions between deficit hawks and patient advocates have moved from background noise to the central negotiating dynamic on Capitol Hill. Agency leaders at CMS and HHS are navigating a peculiar limbo — issuing guidance and defending programs they know may be restructured before the ink dries. Readers should watch the Senate Finance Committee closely, as the markups expected in coming days will signal which sacred cows are actually on the table and which political coalitions hold.
